RECT sample encrypted text — try Crypto helpers with these lines.

1) Base64 (paste into Input, op=decode, encoding=base64 or auto):
ZmxhZ3tiYXNlNjRfMTNfZWFzeX0=

2) Hex (op=decode, encoding=hex):
666c61677b6865785f6465636f6465727d

3) URL-encoded (op=decode, encoding=url):
flag%7BurL_d3c0d3%7D

4) ROT13 (op=decode, encoding=rot13):
synt{ebg13_znmrf_zr_qnmmyr}

5) Caesar shift 7 (op=caesar, key=7):

(best-shift auto also works: op=caesar, key empty)

6) Vigenère key=RECT (op=vigenere, key=RECT):

7) XOR key 0x42 (op=xor, key=B):
